question.:question/problem:
Given that

$$
T=\begin{bmatrix}4 & -2 & 3 \\ -9 & 6 & -11 \\ -3 & 4 & -12\end{bmatrix}
$$

which of the following elementary row operations makes $a_{13}=0$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation

$$
{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3}.
$$

At the requested entry, this gives

$$
a_{13}=3+\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)\cdot (-12)=0.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}T &=\begin{bmatrix}4 & -2 & 3 \\ -9 & 6 & -11 \\ -3 & 4 & -12\end{bmatrix}\qquad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3} \\ &\sim \begin{bmatrix}\frac{13}{4} & -1 & 0 \\ -9 & 6 & -11 \\ -3 & 4 & -12\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3}.
$$
